actual.titulo: 911: Did the Killer Call • The First Suspect
actual.descripcion: The First Suspect | A woman vanishes, and her husband calls 911; months later, police find her badly beaten body and make him suspect no. 1; a strange noise in the background of a 911 call leads police to the true killer.

lista.descripcion: Goodnight Jessika | Twenty-seven-year-old Jessika Kalaher is found strangled in her car in Cedar Park, Texas; with Jessika's wallet and car keys missing, detectives turn to security cameras in the hope of finding out who killed her.
